title: Report a dead worker agent as a typed died outcome in seconds, not after the idle timeout
action: Per D1/D2/D3, slice 1 of the plan. (1) Herdr trait (run.rs:268-329) gains `fn process_info(&self, pane_id: &str) -> Liveness`, a new tri-state enum Alive { pid: u32 } | Absent | Unknown. RealHerdr runs `herdr pane process-info --pane <id>` and reads result.process_info.foreground_processes[] plus shell_pid. AGENT-PRESENT MEANS: at least one foreground entry whose pid != shell_pid — NEVER a name match against the agent kind, because an agent that shells out to cargo or git puts a different name in its own foreground group and a name match would read that as a death. Only shell_pid present => Absent. FAIL OPEN (D2): a spawn failure, non-zero exit, error envelope, or unparseable body all return Unknown — the OPPOSITE direction from pane_alive (run.rs:454), which fails closed on purpose; copying its shape here would kill healthy multi-hour jobs on a herdr hiccup. Add the method to FakeHerdr (run.rs:1697) with scriptable per-call responses and to PanicHerdr (run.rs:1753). (2) run_poll_loop (run.rs:564) owns the debounce beside last_heartbeat_ms: read liveness every 10th tick (~2s, since each read spawns a subprocess), N = 3 consecutive Absent reads arm the died verdict; Alive AND Unknown both RESET the counter to zero (D3 — an Absent/Unknown/Absent interleave must never fire died). Carry the armed state plus the last-seen pid into PollTick. (3) decide_poll (run.rs:518) gains a liveness parameter and a new PollDecision::Died { pid: Option<u32> } rung placed BETWEEN the ceiling check (run.rs:530-531) and the stale-heartbeat check (run.rs:533), so result still short-circuits everything and timed_out_ceiling still wins every tie. Its seven existing direct callers (run.rs:1515, 1520, 1525, 1530, 1538, 1550, 1558) and the production caller (run.rs:581) pass the neutral value (Unknown, counter zero); EVERY EXISTING ASSERTION MUST STAY BYTE-IDENTICAL — an assertion you have to change means the rung went in wrong. (4) RunOutcome gains Died, following the hlp-1 precedent for paused_limit: extend the three PollDecision->RunOutcome matches (run.rs:1106, 1255, 1378), outcome_label (run.rs:1406-1420) with the string "died", and emit_result's payload match (run.rs:1441-1466, exhaustive with no catch-all) carrying the vanished pid as forensics. VERIFY AND LEAVE ALONE: exit_code_for (run.rs:1422-1428) already lands Died on FAILURE through its catch-all, and the close gating (run.rs:1117-1118) already leaves a died pane OPEN unless --close-always, which is the wanted forensics behaviour. Do NOT touch record_dispatch or the wave ledger — no run outcome reaches them today and this cell does not change that. Do NOT add any /proc read: D6 refused the CPU signal and parked hang detection. Tier 2 keeps its current membership (log.txt mtime OR agent_status working) untouched.

truths: Three consecutive Absent liveness reads with no result yield outcome died, and the pane stays open unless --close-always
A liveness read that errors, returns an error envelope, or is unparseable yields Unknown and the poll CONTINUES — never died (D2)
An Absent/Unknown/Absent interleave resets the counter and does not fire died (D3)
A foreground process present with a non-agent name and pid != shell_pid counts as ALIVE, so an agent shelling out to a build is never killed
Ceiling passed AND armed-died in the same tick yields TimedOutCeiling, proving the rung sits below the ceiling check
Every pre-existing decide_poll and run_poll_loop assertion is unchanged; only the new neutral parameter is threaded through
No /proc read and no change to tier-2 heartbeat membership

trace.outcome: Dead worker agent now reports a typed died outcome in about six seconds instead of after the 900s idle timeout

checks.evidence: run.rs:645-651 Liveness::Absent increments absent_reads and arms Died at >= 3; run.rs:1201-1202 Died is not a valid result so should_close_pane leaves the pane open unless --close-always. Verified against the diff by an independent read-only pass, not the worker's word

run.rs:498-503 process_info returns Unknown on any call() Err (spawn failure, non-zero exit, non-JSON body, run.rs:344-361); run.rs:507-517 parse_process_info returns Unknown for a non-null error key, a missing result, and a missing or non-array foreground_processes. No error path reaches Absent — the D2 direction, opposite pane_alive's fail-closed gate

run.rs:638-648 Liveness::Unknown sets absent_reads = 0, a hard reset rather than a skip, and no branch tests != Alive. An Absent/Absent/Unknown/Absent/Absent interleave is pinned by a test and does not fire died (D3)

run.rs:519-527 the only predicate is shell_pid.map_or(true, |sp| pid != sp); name and cmdline are never read in the liveness decision, so an agent that shells out to cargo or git is never read as dead
run.rs:576-596 decide_poll branch order is result -> ceiling -> died -> stale-heartbeat, so timed_out_ceiling still wins every tie exactly as CONTEXT.md's outcome table states

Test-module diff reviewed in full: every pre-existing assertion gained only a neutral argument (None for decide_poll, liveness: None for PollTick); no expected value changed. FakeHerdr's default process_info returns Unknown so pre-existing execute tests keep their outcomes
